verdicts.evidence: apps/frontend/src/pages/desktop/DesktopAfterSales.tsx:283-297 move() and :299-314 addNote() both await load(), and load() (:234-248) does setDraft from the server, overwriting unsaved edits with no dirty check. But apps/backend/src/routes/afterSales.ts:443 refuses Resolved when the stored resolution or amount is null, and on that error move() skips load(), so the draft survives. afterSales.ts:25 allows Resolved -> Open.
verdicts.reason: Edits are really discarded on a successful move or note. The scenario as written is overstated. Resolving only works when an amount is already saved, so the old amount is kept, not lost. The case can be reopened (Resolved -> Open), so 'can't be entered any more' is wrong. The note path (losing typed issue text) is real. A lost-typing UX defect with an easy recovery: P3.

verdicts.evidence: apps/backend/src/routes/bankTx.ts:211-212 sell_order_total = SUM(sol.qty * sol.unit_price); sell_order_lines.unit_price is always USD (migrations/0065_sell_order_currency.sql:3-6 'Line USD values still live in sell_order_lines.unit_price'; routes/sellOrders.ts:393 'unit_price is always USD; source_unit_price holds the native price'; :1359-1363 writes the USD conversion into unit_price on non-USD orders). The picker total (bankTx.ts:1229-1236) is the same USD sum.
verdicts.reason: The figure shown with $ is the order's USD equivalent, so a ¥10,000 order shows about $1,400, not $10,000. fmtUSD is correct, and the 'Exact amount' badge compares a USD total to the payment. The failure scenario can't happen. Side note, not this claim: sellOrderCandidates compares against Math.abs(leg.amount) without checking bank_transactions.currency (0153); the PO path keeps non-USD rows out of reconciliation, and nobody checked whether the sell-order link path does too.
